art_direction: 一小段雨后巷道收在剖面方块中，青砖、暖窗和积水反光呈现精细城市切片。
composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: Create an isometric cutaway of a short rain-washed alley, contained within a compact rectangular block. Two modest buildings lean around a narrow passage, one with dark teal brick and the other with warm plaster. A single amber window and a plain hanging lantern reflect in a shallow puddle. Include a small drain, uneven paving stones, a metal downpipe, and a few damp wall patches, but no signs or readable text. The buildings stop below roof level so the alley remains open and visible from above. Use a pale mist-gray background. Concentrate detail in the central passage and let the block edges remain clean, like a carefully composed architectural model.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
